## What you did
- Prod PG17 cutover is prepped end to end: blue/green Terraform on `kestrel-prod-pg` (17.2, PG17 parameter group, `apply_immediately = false`), with the read replica following the green via `ignore_changes` instead of being replaced — plan shows 2 changes, 0 destroys — plus `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md`, all in PR #321 with Maya as reviewer [1].
- Rehearsed the full blue/green on a restored prod snapshot clone: green ready in 52 min, switchover cost **74 s of write downtime** with replication lag under 1 s and no row-count mismatch on the 20 biggest tables; rehearsal instances deleted afterward [1].

## What changed
- The cutover window moved to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00 UTC; Maya confirmed with Sam and already told the CSMs [8].
- Maya approved #321 — her only condition (window confirmed with Fernhill before merging) is now met, so the merge is cleared [3][8].
- Renovate opened #320: AWS provider 5.80 → 5.82, automerge disabled [4].

## What is still open
- Rollback rehearsal, still a TODO in the runbook: fresh clone **Thursday 19/11**, measure how long rollback takes and what data is lost — after switchover the old blue gets no writes and diverges, so rollback is not a switch-back [1].
- Update the window in `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md` and on the Notion "PG17 production cutover" page (still showing Saturday 21/11) to Sunday 22/11 02:00–04:00 UTC, then merge #321 [1][8][10].
- Sunday coordination: ping Daniel Levi when the switchover starts — he's on call for the API side [7]; and give Lior Ben-David 30 min notice before switchover so he can pause the ingest consumers (KES-530 — workers read `DATABASE_URL` from SSM, nothing to change on our side) [9].
